name: Muntin
description: A frame divided into nine panes by two bars each way.

code.style: --rule: ( --bar: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { border: calc(4px * 6 / @size-col) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 32%, @var(--bar) 32% 36%, transparent 36% 64%, @var(--bar) 64% 68%, transparent 68% 100%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 32%, @var(--bar) 32% 36%, transparent 36% 64%, @var(--bar) 64% 68%, transparent 68% 100%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
